title: Indetermination
summary: INDETERMINA'TION, noun [in and determination.] 1. Want of determination; an unsettled or wavering state, as of the mind. 2. Want of fixed or stated direction.

inlines.v: INDETERMINA'TION, noun [in and determination.] 1. Want of determination; an unsettled or wavering state, as of the mind. 2. Want of fixed or stated direction.
